notes: Small TypeScript ports of selected functions only. No Go code, Go libraries (gjson, lazyre) or other Magpie files are included. Magpie is not needed at runtime. Third-party material listed in Magpie's THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES was not ported.

ports.modifications: Object key rename instead of gjson byte splicing; same regex. Added TokenFieldCache (bounded, TTL, keyed by endpoint + model). The caller in apps/server/src/core/ai/client.ts only corrects on HTTP 400/422 with a JSON error message, skips quota/rate/context-length codes and the field already sent, and corrects at most once per call.

functions: writeKeptError (error object and error.message string check only)
ports.modifications: Shape (openai / anthropic / gemini / unknown) is read from the response body rather than a configured protocol. The vendor body is never passed through: setErrorField, tooLong, saysBusy and message rewriting are not ported. Callers receive a fixed Chinese message, a stable code and numeric/enum metadata only (classifyStatus, aiErrorResponse are Starter's own).
Parsing only; no cap and no settings dependency. The advised wait is returned rounded up to whole seconds and kept in the Retry-After header and retryAfter field.

One lane for the configured endpoint; no account routing, laneMate, waitMate, RPM, rests or status endpoint. Queue length and wait are always bounded; per-actor limit on active plus waiting requests (actor_limit); AbortSignal instead of context; release is idempotent; per-actor counters are deleted at zero.
